figurative_meaning_bn: একটুও না, মোটেই গ্রাহ্য না করা
figurative_meaning_en: Not at all, to completely disregard or not care in the slightest
example_sentences_in_bangla: তার মতামত থোড়াই কেয়ার করব না।
example_sentences_in_english: I don't care about you at all.
I couldn't care less about his opinion.
note: This idiom is a blend of Bengali and English, popular in urban colloquial speech to express sarcasm.
